rule: REQ40-H4. Pool P0 at k ≤ P0 ranks as the first k of search(limit=P0), measured by calling comp03_answer.retrieve with the fathomdb-hybrid arm at top_k = P for P in {10, 20, 50, 100}. Reference: P0 = 10. Constraints on the selection set: for every type, the session Recall-any@5 and Recall-any@10 counts are at least the reference minus 1; overall, the Recall-any@5, Recall-any@10 and Recall-all@10 counts are at least the reference minus 1. Choice: the largest P0 that meets every constraint; the reference meets them by construction. k = 20 and the answer set are reported, not used.
